assertion.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 removes an unused option (PR #6557), but the release notes do not name which option, so its identity, exposure condition, and consequence cannot be determined from the evidence.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence only says 'remove unused option'; it does not name the option, so no family identity (cli-flag, env-var, helm-value, config-key, feature-gate) can be pinned.; applicability: The evidence does not identify the option, so no condition (values-key, cli-flag, env-var, feature-gate, or config-key) can be written to test whether an environment sets or uses it.; consequence: The evidence only calls the option 'unused'; it does not state what happens to an environment that had it set (ignored, rejected, or no effect), and the option itself is unnamed.
